findings.title: Loan-length popup listbox: Esc does not close it and Tab cycles inside the open options
findings.description: Expected (APG listbox popup / select-only combobox): while the popup is open, Esc closes it and returns focus to the button, and Tab leaves the widget and closes it. With the popup open, repeated Tab and Shift+Tab move only between 'One week' and 'Two weeks' (probes/61 t1, t3, t6 at 320 px), so the rest of the page cannot be reached until an option is committed with Enter or Space. findings.title: Pick-up session radios are shown in reverse date order, but focus and arrow keys follow the DOM order
findings.description: Expected: focus order and reading order match the visual order (2.4.3, 1.3.2). Current: on /basket.html the six session radios appear newest first (Wednesday 28 October at the top or full width, then 24, 21, 17, 14, 10) at both 1280 px and 320 px. The DOM and accessibility tree list them oldest first (Saturday 10 October first). Tab from 'Remove' lands on Saturday 10 October, the last item on screen (bottom right at 1280 px, bottom at 320 px). ArrowDown then moves to Wednesday 14 October, which sits to its left or above it, so arrow navigation runs against the visual layout.
findings.impact: Keyboard and screen-magnifier users see focus start at the end of the list and move backwards. Screen-reader users hear a different order from the one sighted helpers see. This is the step where members pick their session, the critical task.

The product's own world (the community-centre room, the membership card whose green is cited in DESIGN.md, the session rhythm of Saturday mornings and Wednesday evenings) is absent from the visuals.
findings.impact: The service is likely to feel interchangeable with any booking form, weakening the 'neighbourly' attribute the brief asks for.
findings.recommendation: Choose one signature from the library's own mechanism (for example the session rhythm, already present as 'Open' tags) and carry it quietly across pages; let the masthead be a designed mark rather than body text.

findings.title: Basket session cards: latest-first order and one oversized card above five cramped ones
